name: bld3_edelstein_iterates_tendsto_uniformly
statement: {X : Type*} [MetricSpace X] [CompactSpace X] (f : X → X) (hf : ∀ x y : X, x ≠ y → dist (f x) (f y) < dist x y) (p : X) (hp : f p = p) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε) : ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n : ℕ, N ≤ n → ∀ x : X, dist (f^[n] x) p < ε
closed: ∀ {X : Type*} [MetricSpace X] [CompactSpace X] (f : X → X) (hf : ∀ x y : X, x ≠ y → dist (f x) (f y) < dist x y) (p : X) (hp : f p = p) (ε : ℝ) (hε : 0 < ε), ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n : ℕ, N ≤ n → ∀ x : X, dist (f^[n] x) p < ε
informal: Uses Mathlib2.bld_edelstein_iterates_tendsto: the continuous functions x ↦ dist (f^[n] x) p decrease in n and tend to 0 pointwise by the library theorem; Dini's argument (the open sets {x | dist (f^[n] x) p < ε} increase and cover the compact X) gives uniformity.
type: ∀ {X : Type u_1} [inst : MetricSpace X] [CompactSpace X] (f : X → X), (∀ (x y : X), x ≠ y → dist (f x) (f y) < dist x y) → ∀ (p : X), f p = p → ∀ (ε : ℝ), 0 < ε → ∃ N, ∀ (n : ℕ), N ≤ n → ∀ (x : X), dist (f^[n] x) p < ε
